scientific_question: At fixed tau_int=3, does the latent K2 origin-state process need to persist across artificial line boundaries, or is line-wise state reset equivalent/better?

parent_phase6.outcome_policy: Phase 7 is preregistered before Phase-6 adjudication is visible. It does not select a dwell law from Phase 6; fixed and geometric tau=3 are locked parallel strata. If the Phase-6 endpoint replication guard fails, Phase 7 must not be launched.

invariants.document_rule: canonical ReM documents with >=2000 clean tokens; use first 2000
invariants.rotation_offset_rule: exact Phase-4 K2 within-token half-rotation rule

fixed_tau3.continuous_law: exact Phase-4 FIXED_RUN3_K2 over all 2000 tokens
fixed_tau3.reset_law: restart an independent FIXED_RUN3_K2 process at each 10-token line boundary

geometric_tau3.continuous_law: exact Phase-4 MARKOV_M4_K2 (p_stay=3/4) over all 2000 tokens
geometric_tau3.reset_law: restart an independent MARKOV_M4_K2 process at each 10-token line boundary

common_random_numbers.line_reset_seed: derive deterministic line-specific seed from the same P5-state numeric seed and the label 'P7-LINE-RESET'; this is the intended reset intervention

primary_test.metric: robust d3 = worst ATOMIC/LITERAL distance_of_median_Q3; lower is better
primary_test.paired_difference: Delta_reset = d3_line_reset - d3_continuous; positive means continuity is better
primary_test.materiality_basis: Inherited prospectively from the Phase-4 same-law control upper 95% CI 0.0361, rounded up to 0.04.

replication_guard.rule: Recompute exact Phase-5/6 W10 continuous endpoint medians and require absolute difference <=1e-12.

adjudication_rules.CONTINUITY_REQUIRED_BOTH: For both fixed and geometric strata, lower 95% CI of Delta_reset > +0.04.
adjudication_rules.LINE_RESET_BETTER_BOTH: For both strata, upper 95% CI of Delta_reset < -0.04.
adjudication_rules.RESET_EQUIVALENT_BOTH: For both strata, entire 95% CI lies within [-0.04,+0.04].
adjudication_rules.DWELL_DEPENDENT_RESET: One stratum has lower 95% CI > +0.04 while the other has upper 95% CI < -0.04.
adjudication_rules.CONSISTENT_DIRECTION_NOT_ROBUST: Both stratum medians have the same nonzero sign, but none of the preceding rules applies.

secondary.boundary_local_diagnostics: report within-line versus across-line adjacent token statistics descriptively only; not used for model selection

execution_guard.rule: Protocol, code, preregistration and target-free QA are committed before the workflow. Workflow launch occurs only after Phase-6 endpoint replication status is known; if Phase-6 replication fails, no Phase-7 scoring.
